def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=0]
    if not cells: return [r[:] for r in g]
    r0=min(i for i,j in cells); r1=max(i for i,j in cells)
    c0=min(j for i,j in cells); c1=max(j for i,j in cells)
    inner=g[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]
    oc=g[r0][c0]
    incells=[(i,j) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1) if g[i][j]!=oc]
    ih=max(i for i,j in incells)-min(i for i,j in incells)+1
    iw=max(j for i,j in incells)-min(j for i,j in incells)+1
    n=min(ih,iw)
    cm=(c0+c1)//2; rm=(r0+r1)//2
    t=1
    while r0+t<=r1 and g[r0+t][cm]==oc: t+=1
    t2=1
    while c0+t2<=c1 and g[rm][c0+t2]==oc: t2+=1
    ring=min(t,t2)
    tf=max(1, n-ring+1)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(max(0,r0-tf),min(h,r1+tf+1)):
        for j in range(max(0,c0-tf),min(w,c1+tf+1)):
            if g[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=inner
    return out
